create_RGBDAFrame: create an RGBDAFrame dataclass instance with image, mask, and depth numpy arrays
create_RGBDAFrame_with_depth_mask: create an RGBDAFrame dataclass instance with an optional depth_mask numpy array
use_CO3DTask_MANY_VIEW: use the CO3DTask enum MANY_VIEW value for many-view reconstruction tasks
use_CO3DTask_FEW_VIEW: use the CO3DTask enum FEW_VIEW value for few-view reconstruction tasks
use_CO3DSequenceSet: use the CO3DSequenceSet enum to select train, dev, or test sequence sets
